title: Fishermen from Bandar Lengeh, detained in the UAE, return to Hormozgan.
text:
Fishermen from Bandar Lengeh, detained in the UAE, return to Hormozgan."

"Ten fishermen from Hormozgan province, who had been detained in the UAE since late August, arrived in Bandar Abbas this morning after returning to the country on Friday."
